## Suggested structure

You can organize this course with:

- `downloads/` for PDFs and files students can download
- `notebooks/` for Jupyter notebooks
- additional `.qmd` pages if you later want one page per lecture

## Notes

If a file is not ready yet, you can keep the placeholder names and replace them later with the real files.
